root: ^Assassin! You watch the woman as she inches closer to you. As you move the candle to get a better look, her sword reflects its light back to you.

c-0: ^You know there is no way you can win against her. You are just a monk and barely trained
c-1: ^This seems like the best option. You take off running.
c-2: ^If you throw your candle, it could go out and you can barely see as it is.
